content.comment_body: Hello, I'm facing a similar issue: when simulating, the clock works as expected, but on the [product_name] with [version_no], activating the output keeps it ON even after the set time has elapsed. I used seven user-defined functions, and the issue occurs in only one of them. I tried creating a new user-defined function with a different name, but encountered the same problem. After changing the output configuration, I ended up with two issues. I'm considering replacing the [product_name], but it's brand new. Thanks in advance.
A screenshot of a part of the user-defined function isn't sufficient. Please upload the user-defined function for further assistance.
Alright, I will send it tomorrow as I'm currently working through the night. Thank you.
Good morning [user_name], you can download it from here: [url]. However, I still can't identify the issue.
I recommend having [company_name] review your user-defined function and LSC diagram where the UDFs are called. To do this, open a Support Request.
Alright [user_name], I will proceed with the suggestion.

After submitting a support request to [company_name], I discovered a mistake with the input on the user-defined function—I used a function without a proper signal. It's important to set unused inputs to either a high or low level. Out of seven instances, two were left unset, causing the UDF to interpret them as 'high', resulting in different output behavior. Thanks for the help.
This is a known issue. Also, you only uploaded the user-defined function to the forum without including the full program, so it's difficult for us to fully analyze it.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a problem with the output staying ON after the configured time on a [product_name] [version_no], which was traced back to improper handling of user-defined function inputs. Unused or incorrectly set inputs led to unexpected behavior. Correctly configuring input states resolved the inconsistency, clarifying the importance of proper UDF configuration and understanding how unused inputs affect execution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates reliable and consistent program performance in both simulation and actual hardware, expecting unused inputs in user-defined functions not to unintentionally impact output behavior.
